title: Shared shapes of the lean-business capability's files
description: The shapes every schema of the capability shares, so each is written once: ids and the references between files (lean-business DEC-002 point 7), calendar days and the record of who acted and when (DEC-002 point 2), fingerprints (point 13), and the method's small vocabularies. The capability's Python reads the same id and reference patterns (`scripts/_lib/ids.py`), and a test holds the two equal.

segment.description: One part of an id: lower-case words of letters and digits, joined by single hyphens, starting with a letter (DEC-002 point 7). An idea's id, which is its folder's name, is one segment.

idea-qualified-id.description: The id of a variant, an experiment or a cycle: the idea's id and the subject's own, joined by a full stop, such as `board-game.platform` (DEC-002 point 7).

variant-qualified-id.description: The id of a canvas entry or an assumption: its variant's id and its own, joined by a full stop, such as `board-game.platform.setup-takes-long` (DEC-002 point 7).

canvas-ref.description: A reference to a variant, by its canvas: `[canvas:<variant id>]` (COR-019; DEC-002 point 7). It must name a variant of the same idea, which the capability's check holds.

assumption-ref.description: A reference to an assumption: `[assumptions:<assumption id>]` (COR-019; DEC-002 point 7).

experiment-ref.description: A reference to an experiment: `[experiment:<experiment id>]` (COR-019; DEC-002 point 7).

cycle-ref.description: A reference to a cycle: `[cycle:<cycle id>]` (COR-019; DEC-002 point 7).

day.description: A calendar day, `YYYY-MM-DD` (lean-business DEC-003 point 1). Every date the capability reads is a day, never a time.

person.description: Who made a judgement or took an act, in words: a name, with an address where the project uses one.

authors.description: Who wrote it, one person or a team.

fingerprint.description: A digest of what a judgement judged or a declaration fixed (DEC-002 point 13): the version of the canonical form it was taken with, and the SHA-256 of the covered data's canonical text, in lower-case hexadecimal.

form.description: The version of the canonical form the fingerprint was taken with.

factory-step.description: A step of the customer factory, the steps a customer passes through (DEC-001 point 7).

period.description: A span of the calendar that an amount or a length is counted in.

amount-per-period.description: An amount of money in each period, in the project's currency.

length.description: A length of time, counted in periods.
